context: w0 re-reads living docs and the live ruleset. w1 updates the stale ci-required-result aggregation list. w2 is a decision gate with exactly one outcome: AMEND_GOVERNANCE (docs/decision records match live ALLGREEN and 60-minute timeout) or REVERT_LIVE (operator restores ONLY_NON_FAILING and 45 minutes; this item only records the request, it does not change the ruleset). w3 applies only the docs side of the chosen outcome and notes that ruleset_drift_check does not inspect merge_queue parameters.
description:
First item in the CI-waste (Dan Luu) sequence. Make the operator-facing docs match the jobs and merge-queue parameters that actually gate develop, then choose exactly one outcome for the live-vs-recorded queue-parameter mismatch.

Also record, in the same docs change, that required-ci-coverage-deepest-reproducers remains in force: slow-marked reproducers stay in required PR CI until a later item explicitly supersedes that decision with a real post-merge slow lane (pytest -m slow plus signature plus EXPECTED_SIGNATURE_JOBS). Sending slow tests to post-merge today executes nothing.

This item does not skip required checks, does not edit pr.yml job membership, and does not mutate GitHub ruleset settings.

anti_patterns.dont: add merge_queue inspection to ruleset_drift_check in this item
anti_patterns.instead: defer a drift-check extension unless a later item authorizes it
anti_patterns.why: out of scope; only note the gap
repo-admin-settings already owns the aggregation list and fan-out narrative

anti_patterns.dont: send slow-marked reproducers to post-merge as if that were a CI destination
anti_patterns.instead: keep them in required PR CI until a separately authorized slow lane exists
anti_patterns.why: post-merge runs make ci-test (fast) and make test-medium (medium not slow); EXPECTED_SIGNATURE_JOBS has no slow job; make test-slow has no workflow

anti_patterns.dont: treat live ALLGREEN/60 vs recorded ONLY_NON_FAILING/45 as a footnote
anti_patterns.instead: choose AMEND_GOVERNANCE or REVERT_LIVE in w2
anti_patterns.why: that mismatch is a completed-decision violation and ALLGREEN re-runs a whole group on one failure

preserves.behavior: Fast-lane count regime remains; do not replace it with a wall-clock fail
GitHub ruleset 15611785 is not mutated by this item
No required PR job is skipped, demoted, or removed
Required develop contexts remain ci-required-result, Results Explorer browser gate, and ruleset-drift
